title: XAJ 模型调参专家 Skill（v3）
activation_policy: Not loaded by ExpertKnowledgeRepository or Agent planning until claims are atomized, scoped, verified/reviewed, and published through governed knowledge entries.

review_items.claim: The expert material allows the boundary 0 < KG + KI <= 1.
review_items.notes: The legacy xaj-calibration Skill encoded KG + KI < 1. Execution constraints must come from the model/protocol validator, not either prose document.

review_items.claim: KE stability limits and an engineering range are derived for the teaching package.
review_items.notes: The text mentions [15,75], derives XE=0.2 bounds including KE<=60, then recommends [15,36]. Store only after kernel/time-step semantics are reproduced.

review_items.claim: Yaogu local perturbation experiments rank CS/SM/KE/XE highly for peak response and CG/KC/CI/CS for NSE response.
review_items.notes: If reproduced, bind to Yaogu, baseline, perturbation scale, time step, routing/DP, windows, metrics and seed. Do not promote this ranking to a universal parameter discipline or Leaf River fact.

review_items.claim: The material proposes NSE/KGE/PBIAS/peak/timing acceptance thresholds.
review_items.notes: These thresholds are not model facts or universal standards. They may only become a versioned project policy after explicit review.

review_items.claim: The material proposes calibration/validation split and warmup rules for the teaching exercise.
review_items.notes: Current campaigns own warmup/calibration/development/final-test windows. Years already exposed during tuning cannot be relabeled as unseen final test.

review_items.claim: The material reports Yaogu calibration/validation scores including NSE 0.770 and 0.887 under different ranges.
review_items.notes: Keep as an unverified case claim until audit script, daily outputs, parameter sets, source data and exact scoring masks are reproduced under a compatible protocol.

known_conflict_topics: read-only structural parameters versus action advice
validation reused for selection while described as independent
local sensitivity generalized beyond its experiment scope
